# Fixtures

Each fixture is a capture plus the inventory it must produce.

```
public/<name>.pcap              capture, public source only
public/<name>.expected.json     expected redacted inventory
public/<name>.source.md         where it came from, licence, SHA-256
```

Before adding a capture:

1. Confirm the licence allows redistribution.
2. Run the leak-detection script and check for real vessel names, MMSIs, IMO numbers, call signs and public IPs.
3. Record the SHA-256 in `<name>.source.md`.

Expected inventories are written by hand from inspecting the capture in Wireshark, never generated by KeelMap itself. Otherwise the test only proves KeelMap agrees with KeelMap.
